user.title: Connect to Yarnotron
user.description: Enter the address of the Yarnotron backend (for example http://192.168.1.20:8989) and its API token.

data_description.url: Where the Yarnotron backend runs, reachable from Home Assistant.
data_description.api_token: The YARNOTRON_API_TOKEN set on the backend. Leave blank only if the backend has none.
data_description.child_id: Name for this child's stories and safety history. Keep the default for one child.

reauth_confirm.title: Yarnotron token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the backend's current API token.

error.invalid_url: That is not a valid http(s) address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the backend. Check the address, port and firewall.
error.invalid_auth: The backend rejected the API token.
error.unsupported_backend: This backend is too old: it has no /v1/status endpoint. Use the Yarnotron-HA backend.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This backend and child are already set up.
abort.wrong_child: The address now serves a different child than this entry.

data.idle_minutes: Start a fresh session after being idle for
data.include_transcripts: Include what the child said in alerts
data.voice_power: Allow launching and shutting down by voice
data.mac_address: Host's MAC address (to wake it, optional)
data.finished_speaking_entities: Voice satellites to give more time to finish a sentence
data.finished_speaking_mode: How long to wait in silence at the end of a sentence

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant checks the backend for safety events.
data_description.idle_minutes: Minutes of silence before the next chat begins a new session.
data_description.keep_listening: Lets the child reply without saying the wake word again.
data_description.include_transcripts: Off by default. When on, alert attributes carry an excerpt and are stored in Home Assistant's database.
data_description.voice_power: Needs a host supervisor. When off, only the status question works by voice; launch and shut down need the buttons or services.
data_description.supervisor_url: Only for a setup where a supervisor starts and stops the backend on a computer, like 192.168.1.20:8990. Leave empty if the backend runs in a container that restarts by itself.
data_description.supervisor_token: Must match the token in the supervisor's configuration file.
data_description.mac_address: Optional. Lets 'launch' wake a sleeping host with Wake-on-LAN. Unreliable over Wi-Fi.
data_description.finished_speaking_entities: Pick each satellite's 'Finished speaking detection' select (for example from a Home Assistant Voice device). Yarnotron sets it when Home Assistant starts.
data_description.finished_speaking_mode: Relaxed waits about 1.25 seconds, so a child who pauses to think is not cut off. Default is about 0.7 seconds.

error.invalid_mac: That is not a MAC address (like aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff).
error.supervisor_url_needed: Enter the supervisor address, or clear the token and MAC address.
error.invalid_url: That is not a valid address.
error.supervisor_not_supervisor: That address answered, but not like the Yarnotron supervisor.
